atAGlance: Cơm chiên chay is vegetarian fried rice, usually with egg or tofu depending on the shop, vegetables, scallion, and wok heat.
whatItIs: Cơm chiên chay is vegetarian fried rice with vegetables, tofu or mushrooms, scallions, and wok heat; some shops may add egg unless you ask.
howToEnjoy: Eat hot from the wok while the grains stay separate. Ask about egg and fish sauce before cooking if strict vegetarian eating matters.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm chiên chay and say no egg or no fish sauce before the wok starts. Extra vegetables are the easiest useful add-on.
worthKnowing: Vietnamese vegetarian fried rice can be simple and satisfying, but egg and fish sauce are the two quiet ingredients worth checking.
goodToKnow: Chay fried rice may still include egg unless you ask; also confirm no fish sauce in mixed kitchens.
travelerCaution: Ask for no egg or no fish sauce if strict.
